name: The Defense of Grom'gol
summary: At Grom'gol, Commander Aggro'gosh guards the Horde's foothold in Stranglethorn Vale. He works to keep supplies moving safely to Stonard by thinning the Lashtail Raptors outside the base camp.

sections.title: Securing the Foothold
sections.body: Commander Aggro'gosh guards the Horde at Grom'gol Base Camp. The camp is vital to a safe supply line to Stonard, but local inhabitants stand in the way.

sections.title: Thinning the Jungle Predators
sections.body: Lashtail Raptors outside Grom'gol threaten the supply line. Aggro'gosh calls on loyal fighters to thin their numbers, then report back for new orders.

faq.q: Who orders the defense of the camp?
faq.answer: Commander Aggro'gosh, officer in charge of the Warchief's stronghold at Grom'gol Base Camp, orders the Lashtail Raptors thinned out.

faq.q: Why is Grom'gol Base Camp important to the Horde?
faq.answer: Grom'gol Base Camp is vital to a safe supply line to the Horde encampment at Stonard in the Swamp of Sorrows.

faq.q: What threats are targeting the camp's operations?
faq.answer: Local inhabitants hamper the Horde's supply line to Stonard. Aggro'gosh wants the Lashtail Raptors outside the camp thinned out.

faq.q: What happens after culling the raptors?
faq.answer: After thinning out the raptors, you report to Commander Aggro'gosh for new orders.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you hold a foothold in the jungle at Grom'gol Base Camp and keep a safe supply line to Stonard.
